name: Up Next
author: Steve B
description: Your Airtable tasks in the Omarchy bar: due today, tomorrow, this week and the next 31 days. Tick to complete or delete, add tasks with natural dates ("fri", "in 2 weeks"), and a guided setup that maps any Airtable table. Works on Airtable's Free and Team plans.

barWidget.description: Airtable tasks due soon, one-click completion, delete and quick add.

schema.label: Sync
schema.description: Auto follows the Airtable plan picked in setup: Live (every 5 minutes) for Team and up, Light (every 30 to 120 minutes, paced to the calls left) for Free, which allows 1,000 API calls a month per workspace.

schema.label: Refresh interval override (seconds, 0 = automatic)
schema.description: Live never refreshes more often than every 300 seconds, Light every 900.
